name: Survival Island
description: A seeded castaway simulation on a 12×12 island: day/night cycle (three actions per day), weather and cold nights, five survival stats (health, food, water, energy, warmth), scarce regrowing resources, crafting (spear, campfire, shelter, signal pile) and hidden hazards such as poisonous berries that can only be recognised by their smell or by eating them. The model sees one compact observation per turn and keeps long-term memory only in a 300-character note it writes itself. Surviving takes steady resource loops. Rescue takes skill, not luck: the supply ship's schedule can be deduced from a logbook page in a bottle and from the passes the castaway witnesses (every pass is reported), and the crew only lands if a signal fire blazes on the summit at midday of a passing day after a night with a campfire burning on the island. It separates models that plan multi-day routines, remember discoveries and time a multi-step plan from those that wander, forget, and die of thirst.
hook: Twelve days on a desert island: can it find water, dodge the poison berries and signal the passing ship?
author: Gauntlet Core
